subject.title: [Proposal] Simplify Model Configuration: Single-Source Reconcile + Session Override Reset

question: Should OpenClaw add official model/session reconcile-reset commands, and what state may they clear by default versus only under explicit scoped flags?
rationale: The requested behavior touches persisted session model/provider overrides, auth profile overrides, per-agent defaults, generated model catalogs, and custom provider semantics, so automation cannot safely choose the product contract.

options.title: Dry-run-first scoped reset
options.body: Add report-first reconcile/reset commands that preserve explicit pins by default and require scoped `--apply` style opt-ins for clearing session, agent, or auth state.

options.title: Diagnostics only
options.body: Keep current precedence and improve status, doctor, and config validation warnings while leaving clearing to `/model default` or manual edits.

options.title: Automatic convergence
options.body: Make default-model changes or resets clear explicit pins automatically and accept the upgrade compatibility break with migration proof.

recommendation.title: Dry-run-first scoped reset
recommendation.body: Add report-first reconcile/reset commands that preserve explicit pins by default and require scoped `--apply` style opt-ins for clearing session, agent, or auth state.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent history across the model/session status and reset code that would need to define the durable behavior.
